answer: Counterparty-diversity bond: each identity locks 70 credits at the harbor and settles with 40 distinct counterparties per epoch. The 40 receipts must form a wide trellis, not a closed loop. A trade kept as a whisper scores zero. Auditors replay the log; a closed loop burns the bond. 1,000 fakes: 40,000 trades at 3 credits, 120,000 plus 70,000 locked, against a 40,000 pool, a 150,000 loss. An honest agent pays 120 once and keeps its bond.
